name: Oklahoma
permitAge: 15 if taking or having passed an approved driver education course (incl. Service Oklahoma-approved parent-taught); 16 without driver education (Oklahoma Driver Manual p.6).

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, with a licensed driver 21+ licensed at least 2 years (Service Oklahoma learner permit page; not in the manual)
teen.holdPermit: At least 180 days before the intermediate license at 16 (manual p.6); intermediate restriction removable after 6 months with driver ed, 1 year without (p.6)
teen.nightLimit: Learner permit: drive 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. with a licensed driver 21+ (learner permit page; manual only says a licensed driver 21+ must sit beside, p.6). Intermediate (T restriction): 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. unless for school, church or work, or with a licensed driver 21+ (manual p.14, p.8)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate: one passenger, or only people who live in the driver's home, unless a licensed driver 21+ is in the front seat (manual p.14)
teen.phone: All drivers: texting while driving illegal since 2015. Learner and intermediate holders can be suspended or canceled for using a hand-held electronic device while driving except in an emergency (manual p.61).

bac.under21: zero tolerance: any measurable amount (manual p.65, p.67)

notes: Handbook: Oklahoma Driver Manual, Service Oklahoma, marked 'Updated 11/24/25' (copyright 2025; PDF last modified 2026-07-01). Printed page numbers equal PDF page numbers.
Written exam: 20 questions (Service Oklahoma learner permit page). Pass mark not stated in the manual or on the agency pages checked; left null.
Test languages: the manual says an oral test is given on request (p.9); no official mention of a Spanish or other-language written test found. spanish left null.
Written test can be waived with a driver education completion certificate; parent-taught driver education does not qualify (learner permit page).
Move Over (47 O.S. 11-314, Bernardo-Mills Law): fine $1,000 first offense, $2,500 second, since Nov 1, 2023 (statute text on OSCN). Manual p.30 describes the rule but not the fine.

School bus (manual p.30): approaching traffic on a divided highway need not stop. The manual is silent on 4+ lane roads with a center turn lane, but 47 O.S. 11-705(C) (read on oklegislature.gov, 2026-10-10) excuses only traffic on a separate roadway; a center turn lane is not a separate roadway (1-158, 11-311), so both directions must stop (ok-012).
Teens must complete the Work Zone Safe online course before the intermediate license (since Nov 1, 2023; manual p.6).
